text:
rachel: quick UX note from today's session: the condensed rows show tiny 'anomaly badges' on the mini-charts and each badge opens a tiny popup. when you keyboard through the row it stops on every badge and it's very noisy
devin: is this the 3-column condensed layout? screenshots?
rachel: yes, the 20px-high micro charts. user testing called them 'mini-trends' and they got interrupted by many small popups
tara: accessibility problem: multiple focus stops per row is bad. suggest exposing a single summary chip per chart that aggregates badges. keyboard focus lands on the chip and reads summary
yun: for visuals we can keep the badges but mark them aria-hidden and make the chip the only interactive element. chip text could be "2 peaks • last 4m" and a chevron to open the detail drawer
devin: copy question: shall we call them "peaks", "anomalies", or "alerts" in the chip? product prefers "alerts" in docs but testers said "peaks" felt more intuitiveachel: let's use "peaks" in compact places and keep "alerts" in help text. tiny UI: "2 peaks" reads cleaner
tara: screen-reader phrasing idea: aria-label="Mini-chart: latest 340ms, 2 peaks. Press Enter to open history". use aria-expanded + aria-controls for the drawer
yun: implementation note: avoid creating DOM nodes per badge in condensed rows. render badges as CSS background and expose one <button class="mini-summary"> with a visually-hidden full sentence for SRs
devin: telemetry: consolidate events. replace per-badge hover pings with mini_chart_summary_open and mini_chart_summary_keyboard_open. include count and whether smoothing is onachel: smoothing: tests show the default smoothing erases short-lived spikes. proposal: disable smoothing in condensed rows, show a subtle smoothing toggle in the expanded history panel
tara: legend/units: the condensed view truncates unit labels. idea: show short unit tokens inline (e.g., "KB/s", "req/s") and full unit on hover / in the drawer. avoids row height changes
yun: small code idea:
```
/* markers visual only */
.mini-badge { background-image: url(...); aria-hidden: true; }
/* single accessible control */
<button class="mini-summary" aria-label="Mini-chart: P95 420ms, 2 peaks, press enter for history"></button>
```
make sure markers are not tabbable
devin: QA nits: pointer-events:none on badge images broke activation for a screen-reader test earlier. better to keep badges non-focusable (tabindex=-1) and aria-hidden rather than pointer-events hacksachel: ux-bot: uploaded a quick mock and a short prototype demo. figma: https://figma.redwood/mini-ux/1932102468
ux-bot: mock and prototype uploaded	ara: plan: yun builds the single-chip prototype -> tara + QA run VoiceOver + NVDA -> finalize microcopy (use "peaks" inline, docs keep "alerts") -> ship behind feature flag. estimate: 1 dev day + half-day QAachel: thanks all — leaving a comment in the figma with telemetry names and the SR copy :thumbsup:
